title: Copy a screenshot to the clipboard on Wayland
summary: Take a screenshot and copy the image directly to your clipboard instead of saving it to a file. Requires a clipboard manager.

steps.explain: Pipe the output of grim to a clipboard manager (like wl-copy) to store the image in the clipboard.

placeholders.name: CLIPBOARD_MANAGER
placeholders.description: The command for your clipboard manager (e.g., wl-copy).

steps.expect: The screenshot is taken and stored in the clipboard, ready to be pasted.
